messages:
Alex M: Anyone able to reclaim 2x A100 slots from the demo-temp pool in us-west2? Need them for an overnight inference smoke (return by 08:00 PST). cc @Kevin L @Maria P

Kevin L: I can try. Quotas on the org look saturated though — which tenant should we carve from?

Alex M: Prefer playground-qa, it's idle overnight. I'll add a temporary label 'temporary:smoke-6599' and note it in infra docs.

Maria P: FYI vendor-side quota changes require a relabel PR + billing tag update. If oncall approves we can do a direct reclaim from the console. @Oncall Bot can you kick the reclaim workflow?

Oncall Bot: reclaim workflow triggered by @Kevin L — step 1: snapshot pool, step 2: remove reservation, step 3: attach nodes to cluster. ETA ~8m. logs: https://ops/logs/6599

Kevin L: Command sequence I'll run (copying from last time):
```
# remove reservation if exists
gcloud compute reservations delete demo-temp-reservation --region=us-west2 || echo 'no reservation'
# terraform target relabel
terraform apply -target=module.gpu_pools["us-west2"].pool["demo-temp"].relabel
```

Samir R: Heads-up — if the relabel changes billing tags, finance might flag it. Keep msg in #finance-alerts if you touch tags.

Google Vendor Liaison: We can temporarily bump soft quota by +2 A100 in us-west2 for up to 6h if reclaim fails. Need PO/short justification.

Alex M: Let's try reclaim first. Kevin, you own the reclaim, I own the smoke test. I'll post results here. If it stalls we ping vendor.

Kevin L: :thumbsup: running now.

Kevin L: nodes are up and joined to k8s, labels applied: temporary:smoke-6599. Node names: gpu-smoke-01, gpu-smoke-02

Alex M: Starting inference sweep (small prompt set). Will report perf & any OOMs.

Maria P: I opened a small relabel PR to keep mappings consistent: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/12345 — it's just metadata. Please review when you have a sec.

Alex M: All good on my side, throughput looks stable. Returning nodes by 08:00 PST and removing the label.

Kevin L: Removing reservation references and tagging returned. Closing the reclaim run: https://ops/run/6599

Samir R: Marking billing FYI done.

Google Vendor Liaison: Thanks — hold the quota bump unless you need it.
